name: Yoshikawa (Saitama, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yoshikawa city emblem in red: an outlined triquetra of three interlaced loops.
history: Municipal flag of Yoshikawa, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 March 1955.

features.role: Yoshikawa city emblem — an outlined triquetra of three interlaced loops
